plugins.name: API Key Manager — مفتاح
plugins.description: Arabic/English API key manager with host light/dark theme. Imports all proxy models and exact-match reference prices in one action; unmatched models safely remain zero. Per-key pricing and actual fallback accounting. No Docker socket or custom image. Linux amd64, glibc >= 2.34; NOT Alpine/musl or ARM64. Tested with CPA v7.2.146. Accounting is estimated; back up state before updates. Read INSTALL.md.
